{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Identify rows with missing 'flipper_length_mm'
missing_flipper = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]

# Check which species have missing flipper length values
missing_species = missing_flipper['species'].value_counts()

# Output the species distribution of missing flipper length values
print("Species with missing flipper_length_mm:")
print(missing_species)

# Also check if the missing values are balanced across species
# Since only 2 rows are missing, we can inspect directly
print("\nRows with missing flipper_length_mm:")
print(missing_flipper[['species', 'flipper_length_mm', 'sex']])"}
